request: 把第5关赖床小猪画得更可爱
artDirection: 小垂耳、圆润脸颊、低位小鼻子、闭眼笑和小嘴。23圆脸，24歪头，25鼓脸。保留红墙、白枕头、棕床头板、纯粉被子和底部前蹄。
export: 1200x1200 opaque indexed PNG, nearest requested CIE Lab palette, no dithering. Imagegen retains original artwork; technical palette normalization only.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: square pixel-art illustration for level 5 "sleepy baby pig in bed", later converted to a 60x60 bubble grid.
The attached image is the PREVIOUS REJECTED VERSION. Preserve its scene/palette/story, but substantially REDESIGN THE PIG to be much more adorable and endearing, with appealing baby-animal/chibi proportions. It currently looks stiff and stern.
Art direction: one very round, squishy peach baby-pig face with plump lower cheeks, a softly domed forehead, two SMALL floppy rounded triangular pig ears that curl/fold slightly outward (not the huge sharp ears in the reference). Facial features group lower on the face with a generous forehead. Two short, gently curved CLOSED happy-sleeping eyes, a SMALLER soft oval button snout with two rose nostrils, a tiny contented curved smile, and two rosy cheek patches. Warm blissful sleepy expression, cherubic and huggable. Avoid a frown, angry eyebrows, adult boar snout, large flat triangular ears, long horizontal face or exaggerated huge nostrils. Make the snout read clearly at60x60 but only aboutone-quarter facewidth.
Keep one big central face occupying the upper middle; white pillow wraps subtly behind lower cheeks, simple brown headboard behind it; pure solid coral-red wall. A flat solid pale-pink blanket covers lower half, no pattern/folds/shading. Two peach FRONT TROTTERS rest on the blanket near bottom edge; make these two adorable small round mitten-like paws with only one SHORT shallow center notch, not large pointed cloven feet, no long arms. Leave a small pink margin beneath paws. One main character, no additional props or symbols.
Uniform axis-aligned chunky pixel art, simple few big stepped shapes. Crisp flat solid color blocks, no gradients, no textures, no dither, no shadows, no anti-alias blur, no text, no ZZZ/hearts/stars. Strong one-cell dark character silhouette readable in60x60. No black outline on pillow, bed or blanket to preserve color budget.

Fully opaque square. Preserve solid red wall and solid pink blanket; foreground must remain distinct.
